"""Bounded independent probes. No model, repo edits, archived controller or source copy."""
import asyncio,hashlib,importlib,json,os,sys,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
from devtools.core.paths import ResolvedPath,resolve_path,parse_dot_path
from devtools.core.time import Timestamp,Duration
from devtools.resources.filesystem import BinaryFile,FileFormat,read,write
from devtools.resources.commands import Command,CommandExecutor,CommandOutputPolicy,CommandStdout
O=Path(__file__).parent.resolve();BASE='0e240ec102e9d54c92a3e85071586a9a8e74b308';cases=[]
def add(name,expected,actual,classification):cases.append(dict(case=name,expected=expected,actual=actual,classification=classification))
async def main():
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='devtools-core-resource-audit-') as folder:
  root=Path(folder);a=root/'a';b=root/'b';a.mkdir();b.mkdir()
  # Literal independent semantics, not another call to the resolver as oracle.
  normal=resolve_path('child/../new',base_directory=a).value
  assert normal.name=='new' and os.path.samefile(normal.parent,a)
  add('ordinary_relative_and_missing','An explicit base resolves missing relative members; it is not an allowed-root policy.',dict(resolved=str(normal),parent_same_directory=os.path.samefile(normal.parent,a),escape=str(resolve_path('../outside',base_directory=a))), 'CONTROL')
  if os.name=='nt':
   old=Path.cwd();drive=old.drive;other='Z:' if drive.upper()!='Z:' else 'Y:';results=[]
   try:
    for cwd in [a,b]:
     os.chdir(cwd);results.append(str(resolve_path(drive+'relative.txt',base_directory=Path(other+'/explicit-base'))))
   finally:os.chdir(old)
   add('drive_relative_foreign_base','A relative input must not silently depend on ambient CWD after an explicit absolute base is supplied; reject incompatible drive-relative inputs or define an equally explicit policy.',dict(input=drive+'relative.txt',base=other+'/explicit-base',first=results[0],second=results[1],cwd_dependent=results[0]!=results[1]),'CONFIRMED_POLICY_DEFECT' if results[0]!=results[1] else 'NO_DEFECT')
  add('dot_components_native_root','Mechanical dot components are not Python identifiers or a containment guarantee.',dict(input='one./escape',result=str(parse_dot_path('one./escape')),absolute=parse_dot_path('one./escape').is_absolute()),'QUALIFIED_LIMITATION')
  target=root/'target.bin';target.write_bytes(b'old')
  try:write(BinaryFile(ResolvedPath(target),b'new'),overwrite=False)
  except FileExistsError:ordinary=True
  else:ordinary=False
  add('ordinary_no_overwrite','Existing regular bytes stay old under overwrite=False.',dict(refused=ordinary,bytes=target.read_bytes().decode()),'CONTROL')
  link=root/'entry.bin'
  try:link.symlink_to(root/'missing-target.bin')
  except OSError as e:add('dangling_no_overwrite','An existing dangling directory entry should not be replaced when overwrite=False.',dict(capability=False,error=type(e).__name__,winerror=getattr(e,'winerror',None)),'PLATFORM_UNAVAILABLE')
  else:
   before=os.readlink(link);error=None
   try:write(BinaryFile(ResolvedPath(link),b'new'),overwrite=False)
   except Exception as e:error=type(e).__name__
   add('dangling_no_overwrite','FileExistsError; the original symlink directory entry remains untouched.',dict(capability=True,before_link=before,error=error,after_symlink=link.is_symlink(),after_bytes=None if link.is_symlink() else link.read_bytes().decode()),'CONFIRMED_DEFECT' if not link.is_symlink() else 'CONTROL')
  # Containment normalization handles a stable link, not a lease across later IO.
  inside=root/'inside';outside=root/'outside';inside.mkdir();outside.mkdir();(outside/'secret.txt').write_bytes(b'OUTSIDE')
  alias=inside/'alias'
  try:alias.symlink_to(outside,target_is_directory=True)
  except OSError as e:add('stable_link_resolution','Stable aliases resolve before consumer containment checks.',dict(capability=False,error=type(e).__name__),'PLATFORM_UNAVAILABLE')
  else:add('stable_link_resolution','The resolved target is outside the selected root; caller must refuse.',dict(resolved=str(resolve_path(alias/'secret.txt')),contained=resolve_path(alias/'secret.txt').value.is_relative_to(inside)),'CONTROL')
  sample=root/'sample.bin';sample.write_bytes(b'abcde')
  r=read(ResolvedPath(sample),file_format=FileFormat.BINARY,max_bytes=5)
  try:read(ResolvedPath(sample),file_format=FileFormat.BINARY,max_bytes=4)
  except Exception as e:overflow=type(e).__name__
  add('real_binary_bound','Exact five bytes return; four-byte cap refuses.',dict(content_hex=r.content.hex(),overflow=overflow),'CONTROL')
  original_open=Path.open
  def changing_open(p,*args,**kwargs):
   if p==sample:sample.write_bytes(b'vwxyz')
   return original_open(p,*args,**kwargs)
  with patch.object(Path,'open',changing_open):
   # Use original_open to avoid recursive fixture writes.
   pass
  changed=False
  def replaced_open(p,*args,**kwargs):
   nonlocal changed
   if p==sample and not changed:
    changed=True
    with original_open(p,'wb') as h:h.write(b'vwxyz')
   return original_open(p,*args,**kwargs)
  with patch.object(Path,'open',replaced_open):result=read(ResolvedPath(sample),file_format=FileFormat.BINARY,max_bytes=5)
  add('mutation_before_open','Generic read returns the actual bytes it reads, not a stat-time snapshot or earlier content identity.',dict(read_hex=result.content.hex(),expected_hex=b'vwxyz'.hex()),'QUALIFIED_LIMITATION')
  # Independent effect-boundary scheduling: destination appears after precheck.
  writing=importlib.import_module('devtools.resources.filesystem.writing');real_temp=writing.NamedTemporaryFile;race=root/'race.bin'
  def arriving(**kwargs):
   race.write_bytes(b'OTHER');return real_temp(**kwargs)
  with patch.object(writing,'NamedTemporaryFile',arriving):write(BinaryFile(ResolvedPath(race),b'NEW'),overwrite=False)
  add('concurrent_no_overwrite','No concurrent-writer safety is documented; higher-layer serialization is required.',dict(after=race.read_bytes().decode(),other_preserved=race.read_bytes()==b'OTHER'),'DOCUMENTED_LIMITATION')
  binary=Command(sys.executable).args('-c','import sys; sys.stdout.buffer.write(b"abcdef"); sys.stderr.buffer.write(b"xyz")')
  h=CommandExecutor(output_policy=CommandOutputPolicy(max_stdout_bytes=3,max_stderr_bytes=1,max_pending_events=1)).start(binary)
  first=await h;second=await h;events=[type(e).__name__ async for e in h.events()]
  add('real_command_bounded_events','One execution, exact prefixes and explicit loss flags; no required terminal event in a saturated queue.',dict(stdout=first.stdout.decode(),stderr=first.stderr.decode(),stdout_truncated=first.stdout_truncated,stderr_truncated=first.stderr_truncated,events=events,dropped=first.events_dropped,same_result=first is second),'CONTROL')
  nonexistent=root/'missing-directory'
  try:await CommandExecutor().execute(Command(sys.executable).args('-c','pass').cwd(ResolvedPath(nonexistent)))
  except Exception as e:actual=dict(error=type(e).__name__,message=str(e),cause=type(e.__cause__).__name__)
  add('missing_cwd_classification','A missing working directory is not proof that the existing Python executable is absent.',actual,'DIAGNOSTIC_LIMITATION')
  # A nonempty stdin may still be blocked while the immediate child is killed.
  try:await CommandExecutor().execute(Command(sys.executable).args('-c','import time; time.sleep(1)').with_stdin(b'x'*1000000).with_timeout(Duration.seconds(0.05)))
  except Exception as e:actual=type(e).__name__
  add('real_blocked_stdin_timeout','Immediate-child timeout propagates as CommandTimeoutError; it does not prove rollback.',dict(error=actual),'CONTROL')
  created=[];marker=root/'effect.txt'
  class ObservedExecutor(CommandExecutor):
   async def _create_process(self,command):
    process=await super()._create_process(command);created.append(process);return process
  h=ObservedExecutor().start(Command(sys.executable).args('-c',"from pathlib import Path; import sys,time; Path(sys.argv[1]).write_bytes(b'EFFECT'); print('READY',flush=True); time.sleep(2)",str(marker)))
  pending=asyncio.ensure_future(h);stream=h.events();seen=[]
  async with asyncio.timeout(5):
   async for event in stream:
    seen.append(type(event).__name__)
    if isinstance(event,CommandStdout) and b'READY' in event.data:break
   pending.cancel()
   try:await pending
   except asyncio.CancelledError:pass
   seen.extend([type(e).__name__ async for e in stream])
  assert marker.read_bytes()==b'EFFECT' and created[0].returncode is not None
  add('real_cancellation_after_effect','Reap the actual immediate child, propagate cancellation, close events without a fabricated exit result; the earlier external effect remains.',dict(returncode=created[0].returncode,handle_complete=h.is_complete,marker=marker.read_bytes().decode(),events=seen),'CONTROL')
  # Both fakes model actual stream/read and reap boundaries. No real child exists.
  class Failing:
   async def read(self,n):raise RuntimeError('independent reader failure')
  class Blocking:
   def __init__(self):self.entered=asyncio.Event();self.release=asyncio.Event();self.cancelled=False;self.complete=False
   async def read(self,n):
    self.entered.set()
    try:await self.release.wait();self.complete=True;return b''
    except asyncio.CancelledError:self.cancelled=True;raise
  class Process:
   stdin=None;returncode=None
   def __init__(self):self.stdout=Failing();self.stderr=Blocking();self.killed=False;self.waited=False
   def kill(self):self.killed=True;self.returncode=-1
   async def wait(self):self.waited=True
  p=Process()
  async def create(*args,**kwargs):return p
  with patch('devtools.resources.commands.execution.asyncio.create_subprocess_exec',create):
   h=CommandExecutor().start(Command('deterministic-fake'))
   try:await h
   except RuntimeError:pass
   await asyncio.sleep(0)
   pending=[t for t in asyncio.all_tasks() if t is not asyncio.current_task() and '_read_stream' in t.get_coro().__qualname__ and not t.done()]
   add('reader_failure_sibling_lifetime','All owned collector tasks should finish/cancel before terminal failure is returned; no background reader remains.',dict(handle_complete=h.is_complete,killed=p.killed,reaped=p.waited,sibling_entered=p.stderr.entered.is_set(),sibling_cancelled=p.stderr.cancelled,pending_reader_tasks=len(pending),events=[type(e).__name__ async for e in h.events()]),'CONFIRMED_CLEANUP_DEFECT' if pending else 'CONTROL')
   p.stderr.release.set()
   if pending:await asyncio.gather(*pending)
 out=dict(baseline=BASE,at=str(Timestamp.now()),platform=os.name,method='Independent literal expected outcomes; temporary filesystem inputs, real bounded managed child processes, explicit deterministic read/reap fakes. No model or production source mutation.',cases=cases)
 (O/'probes.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
